Jesus himself spoke of the happiness and blessedness of those who believe in Him. The name Randa serves as a reminder of the happiness and joy that comes from a strong relationship with God and obedience to His teachings. Therefore, the name Randa embodies the happiness found in both a personal relationship with God and a deep understanding of spiritual truths.
